title: Eternal Domination vs Domination Number
exact_target: Can the ordinary domination number equal the one-guard-move eternal domination number while both are strictly smaller than the clique covering number?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1389 (GRAPH-002). CC BY 4.0.
Tom Adamczewski and William F. Klostermeyer, \emph{A Counterexample to an Eternal Domination Conjecture} (2026), arXiv:2609.11500v1, Sections 1--3, especially Conjecture 3.1.
